name: KEV
primary_diagnosis_explanation: Fever, cough and flu-like symptoms for 3 days in a healthy young adult suggest a flu infection.
secondary_diagnosis_ICD11_Title: ACUTE UPPER RESPIRATORY INFECTION, SITE UNSPECIFIED
secondary_diagnosis_explanation: A common viral infection of the nose and throat can also cause cough, mild fever and cold symptoms.

name: EV
primary_diagnosis_ICD11_Title: ACUTE UPPER RESPIRATORY INFECTION, SITE UNSPECIFIED
primary_diagnosis_explanation: Cough and cold signs for 3 days point to a common viral nose and throat infection. Babies need a doctor to check.
secondary_diagnosis_explanation: Flu-like illness with cough and head discomfort may be the flu. Babies are at higher risk, so see a doctor soon.
